Hi Jordan,

We're kicking off our renewal planning for Q4 and I wanted to share MeadowTech's priorities:
- We expect a 40% increase in inference usage for our recommendation pipeline starting Jan.
- We'd like a short-term committed uplift (3–6 months) to cover the growth, with the option to convert to a higher baseline at next renewal.
- Critical ask: a ~12 month price-protection for the new commit (we can't absorb immediate price increases mid-contract).

Current commit: 150k token-hours/mo. Target uplift: +60k token-hours/mo initially.
Can Redwood do a temporary uplift with an applied credit and a conditional price-hold? If so, what would the discount/credit math look like and what approvals are needed?

Drew (CC) will be involved on procurement side for PO and contracting.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call next week.

Best,

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear ask and heads-up on timing. Appreciate the detail.

We can absolutely model a short-term uplift and a price-protection covenant for 12 months. High level options I want to put forward before a short call:
1) Uplift + amortized credit: add 60k token-hours/mo for 6 months with a one-time credit that reduces unit rate for the uplifted volume; baseline stays at 150k after 6 months unless you elect conversion.
2) Step-up commit with price-hold: move baseline to 210k token-hours/mo for 12 months at a slightly reduced incremental price; includes a conditional IOI (intent to increase) so pricing is locked while conversion can be finalized at renewal.
3) Hybrid: initial 3-month trial uplift with capped overage rate and a conversion credit applied if you convert to higher baseline within 90 days.

I'll attach a short proposal and an editable mutual action plan (MAP) so procurement and legal can track milestones. Ben — can you run pricing for options 1 and 2 and confirm approximate monthly cost and credit amount? Marissa — can you confirm whether ops can guarantee capacity/latency SLO for the temporary pool and how fallback would look?

Samira — when works for a 30-min call next Tue/Wed PST?

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Jordan — pricing sketches below (quick math, will formalize in the proposal):

Assumptions: current blended unit = $0.0048 / token-hour; uplift = +60k token-hours/mo.
Option 1 (6-month uplift + amortized credit):
- Uplift rate: $0.0045 / token-hour for the uplift volume
- One-time credit applied across 6 months = $18,000 (reduces effective rate ~ $0.0042 over the uplift window)
- Net impact: MeadowTech pays ~ $1,620 extra / month for uplift period after credit amortization.

Option 2 (12-month step-up):
- New baseline 210k token-hours/mo at $0.0046 / token-hour for 12 months
- Price-protection clause: unit price capped for 12 months for the committed baseline; overage billed at standard rate
- No upfront credit but longer lock; equivalent annual spend delta ~ +$110k.

Option 3 (3-month trial + conversion credit):
- Trial uplift at $0.0048 with capped overage at $0.0060; if converted within 90 days, apply conversion credit of $22,000 toward future commit.

Recommendation: Offer Option 1 as primary (lower near-term spend, immediate relief) and present Option 2 as an enterprise lock alternative for procurement.

I'll add line items and amortization schedule to the attached proposal.

Ben
